title: Resulting rectangular base
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of 0.3 units along the x-axis. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and extends to (0.45, 0.0). The second line runs vertically from (0.45, 0.0) to (0.45, 0.0219). The third line moves horizontally from (0.45, 0.0219) to (0.0091, 0.0219), and the fourth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0091, 0.0219) back to the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.45 to the entire 2D sketch. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and translating it using the same translation vector of 0.3 units along the x-axis. Extrude the 2D sketch in the direction of its normal by 0.0094 units without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The dimensions of the resulting rectangular base are approximately 0.45 units in length, 0.0219 units in width, and 0.0094 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0.3, 0.0, 0.0))

# Create the sketch for the rectangular top
sketch = (
    workplane
    .lineTo(0.45, 0.0)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.45, 0.0219)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0.0091, 0.0219)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0)  # line_4
    .close()  # Close the loop
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
r = sketch.extrude(0.0094)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.45, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.45, 0.0219) \
     .lineTo(0.0094, 0.0219) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0094)

# Apply the translation
r = r.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0094))

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.4500   # X
W = 0.0219   # Y
H = 0.0094   # Z

# Create the bar
bar = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L, W, H, centered=(False, False, False))

# Small tapered cut at the left end (as seen in TOP view)
cut = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline([
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.012, 0.0),
    (0.0, W)
]).close().extrude(H)

r = bar.cut(cut)

# Reposition so bounding box matches (cut removed a corner, shift base)
r = r.translate((0, 0, 0))

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

L = 0.4500
W = 0.0219
T = 0.0094

# Oblique left end in plan view, about 70 deg from the X axis
xoff = W / math.tan(math.radians(70.0))

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(L, 0.0)
    .lineTo(L, W)
    .lineTo(xoff, W)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)
